resources.string: Progress while the harness is installed or started

This app runs the DeepSeek Harness on your device, and shows it in a window. Nothing is installed until you tap Continue and then Set up.

It needs root. The harness runs inside a small Linux system that only root can create, and the agent it starts runs commands as root. Your root manager (Magisk, KernelSU or KernelSU-Next) will ask you once; after that, each action is a single short command, and this app never keeps a root shell open.

The first set-up downloads about 1 GB and takes a while. Keep the app in the background if you like — the download continues, with a notification.
This will check the device, download a small Linux system, install the harness, lock the ports to this app, and start the server. You can watch each step below.
Leave it alone and it will finish. Tap Log to watch.
